sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - M4A1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I need the help of someone who really knows their way around firearms. You're the perfect fit. People who used to hold a lot of influence in Tarkov stop by from time to time. Funny how everything's been turned upside down - now they're the ones asking me for help. One of them recently ordered an M4. It needs a suppressor, a 60-round magazine, ergonomics at or above 37, combined recoil below 300, a weight of no more than 3.8 kg, and a sighting range above 800."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an M4A1 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Let's have a closer look. Right... the weapon of democracy, indeed. Everything checks out."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
M4A1 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 37 or greater ergonomics
- 300 or less recoil
- 800 or greater sighting range
- 3.8 kg or less in weight
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 60
- A silencer

sections.heading: Builds
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard M4A1 from Peacekeeper LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
